correctness.rationale: A swap changes exactly its two coordinates, so legal swap locations count distinct neighbors. With L=n−2 and Y_i indicating unequal second neighbors, the two end swaps contribute Y₁+Y_L, and each internal swap contributes Y_iY_{i+1}. Each profile of weight w lifts to q(q−1)(q−2)^w proper words, so profile indicators are independent Bernoulli(p) under the uniform word law. Weighting the initial and terminal bits and adjacent products yields (1), and the 2×2 resolvent gives (2). One zero kills at least two terms even for L=1, while the profiles 1^j0^{L−j} give all degrees 0≤j≤L−1; all ones give L+1. Zero degree forces zero ends and an independent interior set, giving the stated path recurrence. The only nonzero covariances involve overlapping products and endpoint/product pairs; for L=1 the same Bernoulli variable is counted twice, and for L=2 both distinct ends covary with the single product. The mean and variance formulas and handshake edge formula follow. Independent direct swap enumeration using set membership confirmed finite distributions, support, mean and variance.
residual_risks: Finite enumeration corroborates, but the all-length assertions require the profile argument. No multi-swap or cyclic model is evaluated.
